subject.title: fix(ui): keep subagent details in the background tasks panel

question: Should Chat’s Background tasks rail intentionally keep subagent inspection in the compact rail detail view and omit navigation to the child-session transcript?
rationale: The implementation and submitted proof support the behavior, but it deliberately changes an existing user navigation path and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve the in-rail boundary
options.body: Confirm that subagents are background work rather than main-chat threads and merge the tested detail-view behavior.

options.title: Retain transcript navigation
options.body: Require a revised interaction that preserves an explicit child-session route for subagents if that remains a supported operator workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve the in-rail boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that subagents are background work rather than main-chat threads and merge the tested detail-view behavior.
